checks: Shared application validator distinguishes missing, empty, null, zero, false and empty collections
Fields follow Schema, compact control sizes, two columns and all four controls fit the default pane
New drafts omit optional defaults; unskip and focus without edits defer visible validation
Skip disables but retains optional fields in Form and omits them from Raw JSON
The exact omitted payload is saved and recorded in scoped history
Cleared required strings and number null show local errors and prevent execution
Numeric constraints and boolean false are validated without treating false as empty
Optional empty string is validated until skipped; re-enable initializes by schema type
Raw omissions reappear as skipped fields; enum values respect their schema
Skip state and validation remain isolated by tab and project and survive theme and locale changes
Arrays keep invalid drafts, validate type and item constraints and block mode changes only for parse errors
No-input tools show an empty state and disable Raw JSON mode
Both themes and locales remain within their scroll containers across desktop and mobile widths
